# Endpoints

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/export_openapi.py from the live app factory — do not
edit by hand; CI regenerates and fails on drift (MP-3). -->

This page is generated from the application's OpenAPI schema on every CI run,
so it always matches the deployed code. Web pages (`/`, `/upload`, `/r/...`,
`/auth/...`, `/admin/...`) are session-driven and not part of the JSON API;
the JSON API lives under `/api/v1/` and returns the
[uniform error envelope](overview.md#errors) on failure.

## `POST /admin/audits/{audit_id}/purge`

Purge Audit.

Manual purge (FR-19/FR-21): removes the raw upload, keeps derived data.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audit_id` | path | yes | string |

Responses: `200`, `422`

## `GET /admin/audits/{audit_id}/report`

| `audit_id` | path | yes | string |

Responses: `200`, `422`
